originalQuestion: One of the distribution centers disappeared from the November intake report.
clarifiedQuestion: List up to 100 distribution centers in ID order with their counts of units stocked in November 2025 UTC. Include centers that received zero units.
humanResponse:
Start with the center list and put the intake dates in the join condition. That preserves a row for each center. Counting the matched inventory IDs gives an idle center a count of zero.

```sql
SELECT d.id AS center_id, d.name AS center_name, COUNT(i.id) AS units_stocked
FROM `tv_thelook.distribution_centers` AS d
LEFT JOIN `tv_thelook.inventory_items` AS i
  ON i.product_distribution_center_id = d.id
  AND i.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00 UTC'
  AND i.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00 UTC'
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
ORDER BY center_id
LIMIT 100
```
